scientific_question: At the frozen sky coordinate of the one-frame LUCI1 Br-gamma marginal candidate, is the measured excess more consistent with a sky-fixed astrophysical flux excess or with detector-local/background/systematic structure?

frozen_candidate_measurement.centroid_source: Frozen 2F-F candidate receipt; Q4A must not recenter it.

coordinate_contract.candidate_sky_coordinate: Derived once from the exact B-frame FITS WCS and frozen candidate centroid.
coordinate_contract.sky_track: Map that exact derived RA/Dec into A/B/C using each frame's own HDU0 WCS with origin=0.
coordinate_contract.detector_track: Use the exact frozen B candidate detector pixel (x,y) unchanged in A/B/C.

detector_control_geometry.purpose: Freeze a detector-local edge-matched comparison ensemble before new forced photometry.
detector_control_geometry.selection_rule: Fixed same-y grid across the 2048x2048 detector, excluding x positions within 128 pixels of the frozen candidate centroid and excluding positions that would put the preregistered 17x17 Q4B patch out of bounds.

q4b_forced_measurement_contract_frozen_i.fit_model: Fixed-centroid circular Gaussian amplitude plus planar background over all finite in-bounds pixels in the 17x17 patch.
q4b_forced_measurement_contract_frozen_i.fwhm_source: Inherited frozen native-PSF measurements from the parent 2F-F sequence; Q4B may not refit FWHM to improve the target result.
q4b_forced_measurement_contract_frozen_i.matched_controls: The frozen same-y detector-control grid above, evaluated with the same patch and fit model.

q4a_success.PASS_GEOMETRY_FROZEN: All three exact frames are retrievable, HDU0 WCS is celestial and finite, B centroid roundtrip is within tolerance, sky-track coordinates map into all three frames, detector-control grid remains valid, and a machine-readable geometry manifest is emitted without dereferencing image pixel arrays.
q4a_success.BLOCKED_GEOMETRY_INCOMPLETE: Any required exact frame, WCS binding, roundtrip, mapped position, or control geometry fails.

not_admitted: No Q4A flux measurement or candidate adjudication.
No use of the closed ZTF/TESS line as evidence for Q4.
No tachyon, faster-than-light, retrocausal, UAP, artificial, ETI, or nuclear-causality interpretation.
